podcast.title: Joining Arcade Fire (Pre-Neon Bible)
podcast.body: Sarah Neufeld joined Arcade Fire as the violinist during the period leading up to the recording of their second album, *Neon Bible*, contributing to the band's evolving sound. "and violinist Sarah Newfeld."
